summary: Completed testing of iteration 15 features for BillHub financial services app. All 8 features tested and verified working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 15 features verified: 1) Virtual Card shows only logo without brand name text, 2) Admin Panel has 'Disable Bank Transfer' toggle with orange card styling, 3) BVN/NIN verification endpoints validate input and check for duplicates, 4) Both USD→NGN and NGN→USD exchange rates are editable in admin panel, 5) User Profile shows read-only 'Verification Address' section when kyc_address exists, 6) Bank Transfer is correctly hidden from Bills Payment when disable_bank_transfer is true, 7) User profile API returns kyc_address field

virtual_card_logo_only.details: Virtual card displays only the brand logo image without brand name text next to it

admin_disable_bank_transfer_toggle.details: Admin Panel has orange 'Disable Bank Transfer' toggle card with proper styling and functionality

bvn_duplicate_check.details: BVN verification endpoint validates 11-digit format and checks for duplicates

nin_duplicate_check.details: NIN verification endpoint validates 11-digit format and checks for duplicates

both_exchange_rates_editable.details: Admin panel has both USD→NGN (wallet_usd_to_ngn_rate, giftcard_usd_to_ngn_rate) and NGN→USD (ngn_to_usd_rate) rate inputs

verification_address_readonly.details: Profile page conditionally shows read-only 'Verification Address' section when user has kyc_address (from Tier 3 NIN verification)

bank_transfer_hidden_when_disabled.details: Bank Transfer option is correctly hidden from Bills Payment when disable_bank_transfer is true

profile_returns_kyc_address.details: User profile API endpoint returns kyc_address field
